resolution.note: precedent derives goal identifiers and finds sibling tests/helpers in php, py, go, rs, npm layouts without Scope; fixture tests assert the sibling and lane brief prints the section

title: Precedent reaches lanes in every stack, with or without a Scope line
body:
Why: Fable 1115g slice 3; src/brain/precedent.ts reads only TS/JS under test/ and only with a Scope: line, so a goal lane in a client PHP repo gets no precedent.
Outcome: the lane brief for a goal without Scope: prints a precedent section naming 1 or more sibling tests and helpers, derived from goal identifiers via git grep, in php, py, go, rs and tests/ layouts.
Files: src/brain/precedent.ts, src/cli/lane-brief.ts, tests.
Proof: fixtures for PHP and npm print a non-empty precedent section; on a PHP row the lane test lands beside the named sibling.
